THE STAY

Your time.
Your people.

Etern Destinations is planned as one whole-cottage stay in Wayanad, Kerala.

Whether your idea of a getaway is a slow start or a day spent exploring, the intention is simple: a comfortable base and the freedom to make the trip your own.

We’re bringing the finer details together. Please confirm the cottage’s capacity, rooms, facilities, accessibility, inclusions and house rules with the host before making travel plans.

BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

A few useful things.

Is this a whole-cottage booking?+

Yes, the booking model is for one whole cottage. The host will confirm the maximum number of guests and the sleeping arrangements.

What amenities are included?+

The final amenity list is being confirmed. Please ask the host about Wi-Fi, meals, kitchen access, parking and any requirements important to your visit.

Can I bring children or pets?+

Family and pet policies are not yet published. Confirm your party’s needs with the host before booking.

What are the prices and cancellation terms?+

Rates, minimum stays, check-in times and cancellation terms will be provided with your booking offer. There are no live rates or instant bookings on this preview website.
